run_projective_texture_demo: run the pybullet projective texture demo that renders a teddy bear with a checker grid texture projected from the camera view
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like plane.urdf and teddy_large.urdf into a pybullet physics simulation with specified positions and orientations
get_camera_image_with_projective_texture: get a camera image using ER_USE_PROJECTIVE_TEXTURE flags with custom view and projection matrices from the debug visualizer camera
connect_pybullet_gui: connect to a pybullet physics simulation in GUI mode and set the additional search path for pybullet data assets
set_realtime_simulation: enable real-time simulation mode in pybullet and continuously render frames using the debug visualizer camera matrices
